ablation.name: d10c_dim32_15ep
ablation.notes: D10c: Aggressive capacity reduction (base_dim 64->32, 50% reduction). Extreme test of style-reliance hypothesis. If DINO-sty increases, confirms that content capacity is the fundamental bottleneck. If DINO-sty decreases or content collapses, confirms baseline is at optimal capacity balance. 32/4heads=8 head_dim, minimal but valid.
